history.note: Where the numbering started.
Commands: !heat, !drama, !camera, !bonk, !current, !state (typed and as buttons in the bar).
Spectrum: Advanced options (Length and Beat sliders).
Command pop-ups stay on screen on phones.
Launcher: the update check reports its result; the start files fetch the launcher when it is missing.
Version numbers: shown in the console, the update question and the interface; core/version.json and tools/bump.cjs added.
Spectrum modes: Normal, Aggressive (bass-focused, more bands) and Custom (sliders).
Spectrum Aggressive: each bass band follows its own level (no longer flat); the rest moves slightly more.
Spectrum Aggressive: same volume as Normal, bass hits travel as a smooth wave through the bass bars.
Start screen: the ZenithTavern update question now comes after the banner and "Checking for updates...".
Spectrum: Audio Simulation slider (all modes) and Lanes slider (Custom).
LunaRouter: a cut-off reply (or cut-off thinking) is continued by the next model before it reaches the chat; up to 6 models.
Smooth motion: Zenith Motion adds easing and enter/exit animations across the interface.
LunaRouter: option to call the same model multiple times (2-10) before giving up.
LunaRouter: change a model after multiple failures (random, similar context length, or a word in the name).
Fix: opening a chat no longer shows 'Something went wrong while saving the character' (the automatic card save is accepted and ignored).
Fix: LunaRouter options layout (failure-switch block overlapped other rows)
LunaRouter: continuation no longer restarts the reply (no repeated header or paragraphs, keeps paragraph size)
Text formats: Phone card (Phone¦ Texting¦ Incoming¦ Outgoing¦) and a bar button that lists formats to copy
Welcome page: ZenithTavern version with release date, and Messages Available counter (OpenRouter credit)
Mirel: scripted-route character with embedded lorebook (roster); Header text format; roster installs embedded lorebooks as World Info
Mirel: removed the softening (no 'nobody was harmed', no toned-down violence or intimacy)
